units.source_text: 这个马戏团最红的明星，特意给自己起了一个时髦的艺名，叫作樱子。

en.t: The most popular star in this circus troupe had deliberately given herself a stylish stage name, Sakurako.

units.source_text: 她骑着马儿，挺起胸脯，脚尖打着拍子，唱着小调从阿光面前走过。

en.t: She rode past A Guang on her horse, chest lifted, tapping the beat with her toes and humming a little tune.
